name: Tarsal Tunnel Syndrome
definition: Compression neuropathy of the posterior tibial nerve or branches within the tarsal tunnel near the medial ankle.

investigations.principle: Clinical diagnosis is supported by targeted testing.
investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI may identify mass or structural compression; electrodiagnostics can assist.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs assess bony causes when relevant.

amber: Injection/decompression requires individualized diagnosis and severity assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada Vata/neuralgia phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Compression neuropathy of the posterior tibial nerve or branches within the tarsal tunnel near the medial ankle.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
